notes.title: 8/27 Memory Leak Fix for NW.JS
notes.content:
8/27 Memory Leak Fix

There was a memory leak issue that occurred with the nw.js engine when using Steam achievements. As a [b]temporary[/b] solution, we reverted to an older version of nw.js.  
Achievements are [b]still [/b]functioning, however the Steam Overlay will currently not work for Alice in Wonderland.   Several other developers are running into memory leak issues with the latest nw.js.  We plan on contacting the nw.js engine creators.  Thank you for patience.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35078791/3e7d4d2fa707014a7cdb112d79b422eb9934bb7e.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35078791/6d497b804c3dc27bef0f456ad9603d9ee46d5cfc.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Hello everyone, welcome to our community!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are pleased to announce our third Visual Novel, Alice in Wonderland [Uncut]. This story is our visualization of Lewis Carroll's Alice's Adventures in Wonderland. Our Visual Novel allows you to read the the ORIGINAL text from 1865 with stunning visuals. Our illustrations are set to revive his sketches from that era. There are several chapters where the user can choose to see the story from a different perspective.  This is the ENHANCED Steam version of our Visual Novel that was released on Nintendo's Wii U.

Brave Rock Games is an independent organization that makes interactive software for young audiences. Our current goal is to bring classic stories to digital platforms. We believe reading is fundamentally important to any child's growth. Some children dislike reading due to lack of visuals. We are bringing visual story tales to these children. We have learned that disabled gamers, also enjoy our software due to simplicity of the controls and production value. Lastly, many adults have approached us to give thanks for creating an application they can enjoy with their child.

If you have any questions please do not hesitate to ask.

Sincerely,

Brave Rock Games
